frequency_question: How often does a besieged state successfully stand up domestic production of advanced Western cruise missiles within two years?
membership_rule: Includes any case where a state at war attempts technology transfer of advanced cruise/precision munitions from an ally to domestic lines. Excludes standard artillery shell or basic drone production lines.

cases.name: Ukraine domestic production of SAAB/Carl Gustaf and various Western artillery/armor systems (2022-2024)
Taiwan Hsiung Feng cruise missile rapid scaling under mainland threat (1990s-2000s)

provenance_note: rate of 0% from only 2 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 2 named; represents the total applicable modern class of high-complexity missile tech transfers under active kinetic destruction.
known_gaps: Classified bilateral agreements between Western defense firms and Ukraine regarding cruise missiles are opaque.
skeleton: Embargoed or wartime tech-transfer attempts for high-end guidance and propulsion systems to a recipient under active bombardment.
multiplier: 2 cases evaluated with 0 hits due to extreme infrastructure fragility and high technical complexity.
validity_reason: Remains valid until the specific technological and infrastructural constraints of wartime aerospace manufacturing change.
